transcript: If I could give you only three treasures from the old Chinese medicine masters, these three alone could change your entire life. Let me share them with you. One, qi breathing. In Chinese medicine, breath is not just air. It is qi, your life force. When qi is low, you feel tired, unfocused, heavy. When qi flows, the mind becomes clear and the body wakes up like sunrise. Just three minutes a day of slow breathing through the nose, down to the belly, can lift your energy more than a cup of coffee ever could. Two, warm water ritual. Most people cool their fire too early. In Chinese medicine, cold water weakens digestion and steals warmth from your center. But warm water, it opens, it softens, it awakens your organs gently. Drink warm water in the morning and your whole system begins the day in balance. Three, healing herbs, the gentle warriors. There are many herbs in the old apothecary, but three stand above the rest. Ginseng for strength, Reishi for calm, Goji berry for nourishment. These herbs do not force the body. They guide it back to its natural harmony. Use them with respect and they quietly rebuild your energy from the inside out. If these teachings speak to your heart and you wish to go deeper into this path, I placed all of my simple rituals, my morning practices, and the old Chinese medicine wisdom inside a small book for you. You can begin reading it today. The link is in my profile. May it guide you gently back to yourself.
